argv: from pathlib import Path;import sys;p=Path('/etc/systemd/system/gb10-gpu-clock-cap.service');s=sys.argv[1];assert not p.exists() or p.read_text()==s,'Existing unit differs';p.write_text(s);p.chmod(0o644)

[Unit]
Description=GB10 GPU upper clock limit (2350 MHz)
Wants=nvidia-persistenced.service
After=nvidia-persistenced.service
Before=docker.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/nvidia-smi -lgc 0,2350
ExecReload=/usr/bin/nvidia-smi -lgc 0,2350
RemainAfterExit=yes
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
